name: codex-ui-customizer
description: Customize the OpenAI Codex VS Code UI, including user message styling and Remote-SSH sessions.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace-defined UI customization values are disabled in Restricted Mode.

codexUiCustomizer.autoApply.description: Apply UI customizations automatically when the extension activates.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.background.patternErrorMessage: Use a 3, 4, 6, or 8 digit hexadecimal color.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.background.description: Background color for user message bubbles, as a hexadecimal color.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderColo.patternErrorMessage: Use a 3, 4, 6, or 8 digit hexadecimal color.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderColo.description: Border color for user message bubbles, as a hexadecimal color.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderWidt.patternErrorMessage: Use 0 or a non-negative length in px, rem, or em.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderWidt.description: Border width for user message bubbles. Supports px, rem, and em.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderRadi.patternErrorMessage: Use 0 or a non-negative length in px, rem, or em.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderRadi.description: Border radius for user message bubbles. Supports px, rem, and em.
